title: Why John Fairhurst at no1 Harbourside is the one gig you should see this week
content:
18th August 2015

Artist: John Fairhurst

Venue: no1 Harbourside

Date: Saturday 22nd August

More info

There’s blues in John Fairhurst’s head that slips through slide-guitar fingers and gruffed up vocal chords and out into a Southern railroad siding or the killing floors of Chicago. It’s so smart you think it’s easy, but it’s not. 

Splitting his time between London and Bristol, northerner Fairhurst is known to many as the ‘Wigan Jimi Hendrix’ – just don’t go along expecting to see a version of Star Spangled Banner in the style of fellow Wigan-ite George Formby.
